# Support

canfit is maintained as an open-source project without a support SLA, and it is in early
development: commands are not implemented yet.

- Use GitHub Discussions, when enabled, for questions and ideas.
- Use GitHub Issues for reproducible bugs and focused feature proposals.
- Use private vulnerability reporting for security issues; see [`SECURITY.md`](SECURITY.md).

Include the canfit version (`canfit --version`), operating system and version, and — once
available — the output of `canfit --json`. Review it before posting: it lists the names of running
processes and model files on your machine.
